correctness.rationale: The factor equations follow exactly from I+U=1-S-sigma C and dot U = dot R+(1-sigma) dot C, with residual C coefficient (1-sigma)(sigma delta-gamma)(1+eps I). At gamma=sigma delta the scalar C fiber has strictly positive damping and the factor reduces to dot I=I[beta-h-beta(I+U)], dot U=alpha I-(a+bI)U. Below/at R0=1, dot I<=-(h-beta)I or -beta I² and all stable linear fibers decay. Above threshold, U=v-I and U=alpha I/(a+bI) intersect uniquely in (0,v); physicality of all steady compartments follows from positive formulas. With q=alpha-bU*=aU*/I*>0, the entropy plus beta/(2q) quadratic Lyapunov derivative is EXACTLY -beta(I-I*)²-beta(a+bI)(U-U*)²/q; I independently checked the cancellation symbolically using sympy. Its properness near I=0, simplex compactness and LaSalle imply global attraction for I(0)>0, then the stable C equation transfers it to S,R,C. At sigma=1 the structural necessity claim is correctly not made.
